note:
The split first-draw capture, and it names the offender. Same device, same ASTC pak (`20:18 12-08-2026`, `build/phone`), app rebuilt with the three-step overlay split ([5757e2b](https://github.com/sexorcist00/opensa)).

**The first `clearRect` is the cost, not the glyphs.** Worst frame 333.1 ms at 310 ms in, zero cells visible, and its segments read: **`overlay:clear` 212.1**, `engine-frame` 77.9, **`overlay:symbols` 22.6**, `stream` 3.4, `board` 2.8, `overlay-2d` 2.0 (the remainder — `projector.update`), `overlay:sketches` 0.6. So **64 % of the frame is the first touch of the 2D canvas's backing store**, and the symbol layer's first glyph raster is a tenth of it. `warmTextMetrics` was aimed at the smaller of the two, which is why the 08-25 row measured no improvement from it.

The window means confirm both are ONE-SHOT rather than per-frame: the split runs for three draws only, so `overlay:clear`'s 0.566 ms mean over 375 frames is 212 ms of total, all of it in the first draw, and `overlay:symbols`'s 0.0885 mean is ~33 ms total. Steady-state overlay is `overlay-2d` at 1.53 ms mean.

**The absolute number is not stable and the SHAPE is.** The 08-25 row measured 1 850 ms in the same place under a taller viewport (609 CSS vs 377 here) and a colder start; this one measured 212. Treat 212 as a floor rather than the figure: it is the same one-shot allocation either way, and what it costs depends on how busy the GPU process is when the overlay first touches its canvas — which at boot is exactly when the WebGPU device for the map canvas beside it is being created.

Everything else holds where the record has it. Resident **76.4 MB** with `target` 37.8 (a shorter viewport than the 08-25 row's 59.9), so content is **38.6 MB for 4 cells** — the third capture in a row to land on that number. Streaming quiet: 14 creates, 0 evictions, 0 late, worst blob 5.6 ms, worst create 23.3 ms. Idle-dominated as always — 140 of 515 frames skipped, the 144-frame spike at 100 ms IS the gate, and `fps 21` is the drawn rate against a CPU body of 4.99 ms (8.2 % of the interval). **5 of 10 symbols dropped** by the declutter at 360x377, against 4 of 13 at 360x609 — the shorter the viewport, the more the map drops, which is the behaviour 3/03 specifies.

Conditions: MGA-LX3 / ARM Bifrost, 360x377 CSS @ DPR 2, ASTC + ETC2, no BC, no `timestamp-query`. District `los-santos-centre`, camera 1467,-1679 h47. Pasted into chat rather than filed through the panel, so the pak line here was read from the `build` field and the device's own pak check rather than from the panel's stamp.
unavailable: gpuPassMs, gpuPostMs, gpuProbeMs — this adapter has no timestamp-query, so GPU time is not measurable at all
